+import json

+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+source = str(ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet")
+db = duckdb.connect()
+
+annual = db.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           min(crash_date) AS first_date,
+           max(crash_date) AS last_date,
+           count(*) AS brooklyn_crashes,
+           sum(number_of_pedestrians_injured) AS pedestrian_injuries,
+           sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrian_fatalities,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_pedestrians_injured > 0
+                                  OR number_of_pedestrians_killed > 0)
+               AS pedestrian_casualty_crashes,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_pedestrians_injured IS NULL
+                                  OR number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL)
+               AS missing_pedestrian_count_rows
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE borough = 'BROOKLYN'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    [source],
+).fetchdf()
+
+coverage = db.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+                                  AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01') AS date_range_rows,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+                                  AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+                                  AND borough IS NULL) AS null_borough_rows,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+                                  AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+                                  AND borough = 'BROOKLYN') AS brooklyn_2013_25_rows,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+                                  AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+                                  AND borough = 'BROOKLYN'
+                                  AND (number_of_pedestrians_injured IS NULL
+                                       OR number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL))
+               AS null_pedestrian_rows,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE year(crash_date) = 2026
+                                  AND borough = 'BROOKLYN') AS brooklyn_2026_rows,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+                                  AND borough = 'BROOKLYN') AS brooklyn_2013_onward_rows,
+           max(crash_date) AS file_last_date
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    """,
+    [source],
+).fetchdf().iloc[0]
+
+data = annual[(annual.year >= 2013) & (annual.year <= 2025)].copy()
+if list(data.year.astype(int)) != list(range(2013, 2026)):
+    raise ValueError("Expected a row for every year from 2013 through 2025")
+if any(data.first_date != pd.to_datetime(data.year.astype(str) + "-01-01")):
+    raise ValueError("An included Brooklyn year starts partway through the year")
+if any(data.last_date != pd.to_datetime(data.year.astype(str) + "-12-31")):
+    raise ValueError("An included Brooklyn year ends partway through the year")
+if int(data.missing_pedestrian_count_rows.sum()) != 0:
+    raise ValueError("Unexpected NULL pedestrian-count fields in the analysis period")
+
+data["pedestrian_casualties"] = data.pedestrian_injuries + data.pedestrian_fatalities
+data["pedestrian_casualty_crashes_per_10000"] = (
+    data.pedestrian_casualty_crashes / data.brooklyn_crashes * 10000
+)
+data["pedestrian_casualties_per_10000_crashes"] = (
+    data.pedestrian_casualties / data.brooklyn_crashes * 10000
+)
+
+null_borough_share = (
+    int(coverage.null_borough_rows) / int(coverage.date_range_rows) * 100
+)
+null_ped_share = (
+    int(coverage.null_pedestrian_rows) / int(coverage.brooklyn_2013_25_rows) * 100
+)
+partial_share = (
+    int(coverage.brooklyn_2026_rows) / int(coverage.brooklyn_2013_onward_rows) * 100
+)
+partial_date = pd.Timestamp(coverage.file_last_date).strftime("%B %-d, %Y")
+years = data.year.astype(int).tolist()
+base = data.iloc[0]
+latest = data.iloc[-1]
+
+plt.rcParams.update({
+    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
+    "axes.titleweight": "bold",
+    "axes.titlesize": 19,
+    "axes.labelsize": 11,
+    "xtick.labelsize": 10,
+    "ytick.labelsize": 10,
+})
+
+
+def finish_chart(fig, filename):
+    fig.text(
+        0.01,
+        0.015,
+        "Source: NYC motor vehicle crash records. Complete calendar years only; 2026 is partial.\n"
+        "Counts are reported crash victims; they do not measure pedestrian exposure or risk per trip.",
+        fontsize=8.5,
+        color="#555555",

+    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(formatter)

+        f"{int(data.iloc[-1][y]):,}" if formatter is None else formatter(data.iloc[-1][y], None),

+ax.annotate(f"{data.iloc[-1].pedestrian_casualty_crashes_per_10000:,.0f}",

+
+
